editorial.blurb: Paulie Gee's Logan Square serves some of Chicago's best Detroit and wood-fired pizzas, with an entire vegan menu and rotating seasonal specials that keep regulars coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server about the full vegan menu and rotating quarterly specialty pizzas—the E=MC² elote and US Pizza Cup Winner Detroit style are standouts, and don't skip the rotating desserts like the vegan cookies and cream cake.
